PUBLIC IP ADDRESS: [eth0] IPv4

Enter: <SPACE><CR> to clear
       ddd.ddd.ddd.ddd<CR> to change
       <ESC> to return to previous menu

The Public IP Address is a text field that is for display purposes only.
It is used for an informational display when the device's actual IP address
is hidden behind another public address.
